items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: I said, thank you, Mr. Murray. I said, you're going to be all right someday... So I kept him in mind all the time. I take mud after I met him

ctx.x: You heard this... No, it was Matthew playing trumpet. It wasn't Matthew.

You heard this trumpet behind you? Yeah. And, you know, a nice good solid tone, you know. And I turned around and we stopped for a break, you know. And we had quit playing and they were still playing. We stopped for a beer break, you know, a sandwich. And he was blowing and I stopped him. I said, come here, I'm telling you. I said, you're doing a good job. I said, thank you, Mr. Murray. I said, you're going to be all right someday, you keep it up. It's all right. So I kept him in mind all the time. I take mud…
Did you used to see him here and there? Who? Did you run into him?
